free_tier.stated: 10 published shows (>15 min) + 10 published tracks (<=15 min). But: 'there's currently no limit to the number of uploads you can have in your drafts'. Drafts are uploaded, stored, and private. That is the actual finding: published storage is capped at 20 items, unpublished storage is uncapped.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: Free streaming for listeners; no egress charge to the creator, but drafts are not publicly downloadable at all, so 'egress' is the wrong axis. A draft has no delivery surface.

tooling: No public API. Desktop-only upload for tracks ('only available through the desktop platform and not the Mixcloud app'); shows upload from web. No rclone backend, no client library found.
chaining: Unlimited drafts x 4 GB per show x N free accounts. Whether drafts are garbage-collected is not stated. The FAQ only says previous uploads are not deleted when you exceed the publish cap, which is a different promise from 'drafts are kept forever'.
limits_note: 4 GB max per show file; shows must be >15 min, tracks <=15 min (so the 4 GB ceiling only applies to long files); 10 published shows + 10 published tracks; RSS-fed podcasts also count toward the 10-show cap ('only the 10 most recent shows will display').

identity_cost.detail: no identity_cost field and no identity statement in the source record; defaulted to email and flagged, not evidence

reliability_note: Mixcloud is a streaming platform: shows are transcoded for playback and there is no original-file download link on Basic. Drafts are inaccessible to anyone but the uploader, which means they are storage but not retrieval. A draft is only recoverable by publishing it, and publishing consumes one of the 10 slots.
